_doc: Fixtures + bars for .harmony/probe-boxes.sh (lane bf9b, s-rta-1002b: decks are boxes of clips; the layers are ONE shared playing stack). Renamed from probe-deck-clock (its rows: ruling-bf9 K6 dispositions, in the .py docstring). Bars are ruling-bf9b's FINAL CONSOLIDATED GATE LIST, VERBATIM (K1-K10): never re-threshold. Pictures 'D<deck> C<col>' are drawn with PIL into the run's fresh out dir; ramp12.mp4 (frame mean G = 255 * t / 12) is made with ffmpeg there. JSON enum ints: Clip MediaType Image 1 / Video 2, LoopMode Loop 0 / PingPong 1, BeatSnapMode Bar 2, AutopilotAction PlayNext 2, AutopilotDuration Beat4 3 (Clip.h); Layer Type Opaque 0 / Transparent 1, MixMode Normal 0 / Screen 2 (Layer.h).

floor._why: floor = max(1.5, 4 x noise), noise = d of two captures of one steady scene 0.5 s apart, same run; tol = 1.5 (OUT -> IN line residual)

video._why: ramp12.mp4: 12 s, 320x240, 30 fps; t = 12 x meanG / 255

k1b._why: K1b: t >= 4 s at the switch; at +2 s |t - (t_switch + 2.0)| <= 0.5 and the REST playhead moved by 2.0 / 12 within 0.06

k1c._why: K1c: Dissolve T = 4 s, switch at p ~ 0.25; on-line residual <= tol; p rises >= 0.15 between +0.5 s and +2 s; complete by T + 1 s

k1d._why: K1d: switch 0 -> 1 at W - 0.5 s and 1 -> 0 at W + 0.75 s

iii._why: clip opacity connected to the signal 'Volume' (= RMS), driven by inject_features rms (deterministic: test mode has no analysis thread)

k2._why: advancing = playhead delta > 0.005 over 1 s; VALID iff >= 2 clips advance

k2v._why: 20 decks x rows 0-2 = 60 copies of ramp12.mp4; awake <= 4 on every sample and == 3 on >= 8 of 10; video_frames_decoded 5-s delta in [3 x fps x 5 x 0.5, 3 x fps x 5 x 1.5 + 30]; the left clip and every non-layer clip move <= 0.001

k3._why: PlayNext / Beat4 over A, B, C; 12 injected beats; R2 switches at beats 3 (-> deck 1) and 9 (-> deck 0); frames at beats 4, 8, 12 vs R1 within floor

k5._why: a Bar-snapped trigger (beatSnapMode 2) queued at beatInBar 1, switch to deck 1 before the bar; fires on the bar (beatInBar 0)

k7._why: an old 2-deck show: Deck 1 / Deck 2 layers differ, Deck 1 / L1 'persistent': true, a Deck-2 row-2 layer connection, a 1.2 s deck fade

k8._why: 20 decks; switch_deck through all 20 within 10 s; activeDeck == target, K1a's bar, peak_frame_time_ms <= 50

k9._why: K9b: Dissolve T = 4 s from deck 2's image to deck 0's, remove deck 2 at p ~ 0.3

k10._why: K10: first capture <= 0.3 s after a fire: t <= 0.5; the re-fire resumes within 0.5 s of t_r; the left clip's playhead moves <= 0.001 in 5 s
